authority_boundary.interpretation: This artifact freezes the leakage-prevention design to be reviewed by Timer. It creates no assignment, seed, dataset, model or performance result.

co_location_rules: All rows and windows from one run remain in one split.
All augmented, resampled or channel-masked derivatives remain with their parent run.
Paired nominal and fault cases remain in one split.
All cases derived from one initial-condition trajectory remain in one split.
Component, subsystem and whole-spacecraft views of one causal episode remain in one split.
Repeated exports, aliases and duplicate content hashes remain in one split.
prohibited_units: seed-only groups that split a shared latent episode

preregistered_holdout_axes.prohibited_interpretation: Not default zero-shot exact diagnosis and not a replacement for BIAS, INTERMITTENT or STUCK.

s0_materialization_audit_summary.interpretation: These statuses record the S0 evidence audit and do not alter the preregistered split rules. NOT_ESTABLISHED does not mean the source can never supply the axis; it means no current governed episode inventory proves it.

future_split_roles.development: Fit only Timer-frozen preprocessing and finite candidate models.
future_split_roles.calibration: Select only Timer-frozen calibration and conformal rules; never refit encoders or heads.
future_split_roles.locked_evaluation: Unavailable in Stage S1; requires a later Stage B approval and genuinely untouched validation seed.

mandatory_leakage_checks_before_any_fit: No telemetry-content hash crosses a split.
No parent-child episode lineage crosses a split.
No overlapping window lineage crosses a split.
No scaler, imputer, feature selector, vocabulary or graph statistic is fitted outside development.
No threshold or conformal rule is selected outside calibration.
No case, scenario, campaign, source, path, seed or split identity is used as a learned input.
All failed, missing or timed-out scheduled cases remain in their original denominator and group.
timer_freeze_required_before_materializa: Exact eligible materialized episode-lineage inventory and every NOT_TESTABLE panel.
Exact development and calibration assignments or new seeds.
Exact task-head model counts, archetype feature contracts, dimensions and preprocessing.
Exact regularization, dynamic-gate rule, conformal rule, finite candidate budget and selection order.
Exact worst-group cells, minimum denominators, confidence-interval rule and runtime accounting.
claim_boundary: Single-source grouped-split design only. source_count=1. No split, seed, truth-informed selection, fit, calibration, validation or performance result exists. Timer must freeze the complete finite Stage S1 protocol before materialization; Stage B and technical validation remain separately unauthorized.
